title: The Chess Game Begins
next_chapter_hook: The Qianyuan Dynasty envoys' procession had already appeared at the periphery of Tianji Palace. Chen Ji felt an unprecedented pressure—the aura carried the exclusive might of 'Heavenly Fate Judgment,' causing the Tianji Record Fragment in his dantian to tremble violently.

text.content: In the dark corridor deep within Tianji Palace, Chen Ji's footsteps echoed against the cold stone walls. The voice from before—the one that proclaimed mastery over all fate—had left not merely words, but a death sentence seared into the depths of his soul. Three months, ninety days, countless breaths—a terminal point awaits him.

He raised his right hand, gazing at the faint black lines on his palm. This was the mark of Heavenly Fate Judgment, like a dormant venomous serpent squirming slightly with each heartbeat. He could sense that power's presence—counting, measuring, counting down.

dialogue.content: 'Three months... more merciful than I anticipated.'

text.content: Chen Ji curved his lips in self-mockery. Merciful? How could an existence like bargaining with the tiger show mercy? These three months were merely the opponent's chess game—granting him hope, granting him struggle, only to crush it personally at the end. The Heavenly Dao's Eye never robs one of choice; it merely transforms every choice into an accumulation of despair.

Light seeped from the corridor's end. The moment Chen Ji stepped out of Tianji Palace's core area, an异样气息 rushed toward him—not the Demonic Path's chilling darkness, not the sect's spiritual resonance, but something grander and more domineering—the majesty of worldly imperial power.

In the distance, golden banners fluttered in the wind. Nine five-clawed golden dragons coiled upon them—the imperial emblem of the Qianyuan Dynasty. The procession stretched hundreds of zhang, armored soldiers standing in ranks, flags obscuring the sun. The leader wore a black official robe, held the Sword of the Heavenly Son, and radiated the aura of late Foundation Building stage—enough power to sweep through any sect branch.

Chen Ji stood in the shadows, his gaze sweeping across the procession. The dynasty's intervention at this moment shattered the balance he had painstakingly maintained for months. The Demonic Path's rivalry with the Three Great Sects had merely been in the exploratory phase, but now with the dynasty entering the field, the situation instantly grew complex.

dialogue.content: 'Boy, the leader is the Director of the Dynasty's Department of Celestial Observation, surname Qin, given name Mobai. This person excels at observing celestial patterns, is versed in divination, and is said to communicate with the intentions of fate.' The Withered Soul Guardian's voice rang in Chen Ji's mind, carrying a hint of solemnity. 'The dynasty's arrival probably isn't merely for Tianji Palace.'

text.content: Chen Ji slightly narrowed his eyes. The Department of Celestial Observation—the dynasty's secret blade controlling Cultivation World intelligence. He had long heard of Qin Mobai, said to have precisely prophesied the outcome of three major sect wars without a single failure. A figure of such caliber personally arriving—his ambitions certainly run deep.

At that moment, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly opened on its own, golden characters writhing like living things. Chen Ji's heart clenched—this was a sign of Restraint Attribute awakening. The foresight that usually required active triggering now manifested on its own. And within those characters, an unfamiliar concept appeared for the first time: 'Twin Fates.'

'Twin Fates... chess pieces selected by the Heavenly Dao's Eye, two lives intertwined, flourishing together, perishing together...' Chen Ji murmured those words, his pupils suddenly constricting. What did this mean? Was there another person linked to his fate beyond himself?

dialogue.content: 'Don't rush to use the Heavenly Fate Value.' The Withered Soul Guardian's voice suddenly turned stern. 'Once the concept of Twin Fates is actively interpreted by the Tianji Record, it will inevitably trigger a chain reaction. What you need least right now is more variables.'

text.content: Chen Ji forcibly suppressed the agitation in his heart. The Heavenly Fate Value was already less than a hundred points; every foresight was a gamble burning his life. The Withered Soul Guardian was right—he needed calmness, needed strategy, needed to tear an opening in this dead game.

However, the dynasty's envoys clearly had no intention of giving him time to think. Director Qin's gaze pierced through layers of shadows, precisely locking onto Chen Ji's position. A slight upward curve touched his lips—carrying the composure of one with everything under control—as he walked forward slowly.

choice.prompt: Qin Mobai was about to speak, and Chen Ji had to decide his posture before he uttered a word—continue playing the cowardly good-for-nothing, or reveal some fangs ahead of time?

choices.description: Maintain the useless persona, greeting the dynasty's envoys with the most humble posture. Let them despise you, let their intelligence deviate.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain intelligence advantage, letting enemies underestimate your worth
choices.risk_hint: If exposed, completely reveal one's ambition

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, his shoulders slightly slumping, his face assuming the customary timid expression. He scurried forward with small quick steps, so flustered in his movements he nearly tripped on his own robe hem—exactly like a Servant Disciple who had never seen the world.

dialogue.content: 'Y-Your subordinate Chen Ji, respectfully welcomes the honored envoy... *cough cough*, this humble servant did not know of the envoy's arrival, failing to greet from afar, I beg forgiveness...' He coughed twice, as if speaking itself required exhausting effort, utterly weak.

choices.text: Exploiting the Situation to Disrupt the Game
choices.description: Using the existence of the Demonic Path Saint Ye Qing as leverage, hinting to the imperial court that the Temple of Heavenly Secrets is no longer pure, introducing more variables to break the deadlock.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing the Relationship with the Demonic Path
choices.visible_reward: Making the Imperial Court Hesitate, Daring Not to Act Rashly
choices.risk_hint: Potentially Offending Both the Imperial Court and the Orthodox Path

text.content: Chen Ji did not step forward; instead, he stood with hands clasped behind his back. He deliberately let his sleeve slip, revealing a faint black mark on his wrist—a contract seal of the Demonic Holy Sect. Qin Mobai's pupils slightly contracted, clearly recognizing what that mark signified.

dialogue.content: Qin Jianzheng has traveled a long way; this seat speaks on behalf of the entire Temple of Heavenly Secrets with gratitude. However—the conversation took a sharp turn, his voice suddenly turning cold, 'The Temple of Heavenly Secrets is now a den of mixed fish and dragons. Some matters, I'm afraid, are not as easily investigated as the Jianzheng wishes.'

choices.description: Proactively offering bait, claiming to possess intelligence about the 'Twin Fates,' in exchange for an equal dialogue opportunity with the imperial court.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing the Existence of the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Gaining Equal Standing with the Imperial Court, Entering the Core Chess Game
choices.risk_hint: Risking Being Used as a Disposable Pawn

text.content: A faint smile appeared on Chen Ji's face, carrying a composure that seemed to see through everything. He spoke slowly, his voice not loud yet clearly reaching each person present. 'Does Jianzheng Qin know of the Twin Fates?'

dialogue.content: This seat possesses some... interesting intelligence, perhaps worth the Jianzheng's attention. As for whether it's worth cooperating—' He spread his hands in an inviting gesture, 'That depends on what kind of sincerity the Jianzheng can offer this seat.'

text.content: Qin Mobai stopped three zhang away, his gaze lingering on Chen Ji for a moment. As the authority of the Department of Celestial Observation, he had seen too many truths hidden beneath surface appearances. Yet at this moment, the aura of this servant disciple before him evoked a subtle sense of uncertainty—a feeling, as if seeing a star that should not exist within a celestial diagram.

Chen Ji? A Tianqing Sect servant disciple, five years in the sect without breaking through to the third stage of Qi Refining, timid in nature, never competing with others...' He paused, a meaningful smile appearing at the corner of his mouth, 'At least, that's what the sect archives say.

Chen Ji's heart tightened slightly. The imperial intelligence network was indeed terrifying, even having investigated his five-year record in the sect so thoroughly. But on the surface, he maintained that wooden, dull expression, only adding a hint of confusion to his eyes, as if he couldn't understand the deeper meaning in Qin Mobai's words.

dialogue.content: Just then, the black pattern deep within Chen Ji's soul suddenly throbbed. A bronze mirror at Qin Mobai's waist emitted a humming sound, its surface flickering with eerie light. That was Heavenly Secret Induction—a unique detection art of the Department of Celestial Observation. Qin Mobai's pupils contracted sharply, his gaze turning piercingly sharp.

text.content: 'Interesting.' Qin Mobai murmured, 'The source of the Heavenly Secret fluctuation my bronze mirror was tracking actually lies within you. It seems the secrets you harbor are far greater than I imagined.' He waved his hand, and the armored soldiers behind him immediately dispersed, encircling Chen Ji. 'This seat has an unreasonable request—please, young friend Chen, accompany me to the imperial capital.'

choice.prompt: The imperial armored soldiers had already formed an encirclement, and though Qin Mobai's tone was polite, it carried irresistible pressure. Chen Ji had to make a choice—force his way through, or outwit his opponents?

choices.description: Pretending to be intimidated, agreeing to accompany Qin Mobai to the capital, but in reality using this opportunity to delve deeper into the heart of the imperial court and gather more intelligence.
choices.visible_reward: Infiltrating the Core of the Imperial Court, Obtaining Key Intelligence
choices.risk_hint: The imperial capital is heavily guarded; once exposed, there will be nowhere to bury one's remains.

text.content: Chen Ji's legs went weak, nearly buckling to the ground. He struggled to maintain composure, but his voice couldn't help trembling: "Your Excellency... what do you mean by this? This humble servant is merely a menial, how dare I defy Your Excellency's wishes..."

dialogue.content: "It's just... this humble one has a request." He raised his head, eyes full of fear and supplication. "This humble one has a long-lost sister at home. If this humble one must go to the imperial capital, please grant permission to search for and bid farewell to her first..."

choices.description: Stop concealing and reveal part of the true strength, letting Qin Mobai realize he is not a soft persimmon to be easily manipulated.
choices.visible_reward: Intimidate the imperial envoys, strive for an equal dialogue status

text.content: Chen Ji let out a soft sigh, the weak aura receding like an ebbing tide. Standing with hands clasped behind his back, his cold, frost-like gaze transformed his entire presence—a sharpness tempered through countless life-and-death battles. "Inspector Qin, respecting your status as an imperial envoy, this one grants you three points of courtesy."

dialogue.content: "But if you believe these few armored soldiers can compel my compliance—" He raised his right hand, black patterns flickering across his palm as a terrifying pressure poured forth. "Then this one shall teach you the meaning of 'Heavenly Secrets Must Not Be Revealed.'"

choices.text: Lure the Snake Out of Its Den
choices.description: Use the Tianji Record for a short-term foresight, identify weaknesses in the encirclement, strike precisely and seize the opportunity to escape.
choices.visible_reward: Break through unscathed and give the imperial court a warning
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate Points are precious few, each one is a lifeline

text.content: A sharp light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes as the Tianji Record Fragment blazed open within his soul. Golden characters surged wildly, fragments of the future flickering past like a carousel—a thirty-breath window when the armored soldiers in the northeast would change shifts; a momentary failure of the bronze mirror at Qin Mobai's waist; and a faint shadowy figure lurking behind distant mountains.

dialogue.content: "Interesting." A cold smile curled at Chen Ji's lips. "Inspector Qin, are you certain you only sent these few today?" Before the words even finished, his form exploded into motion, lunging toward the northeastern gap in the encirclement—where, in thirty breaths, a fatal opening would appear.

text.content: Yet at this moment, disaster struck. The shadowy figure Chen Ji had foreseen was not an ally—but a devastating sword light! The blade tore through the void, striking directly at Chen Ji's heart. The overwhelming killing intent within the sword intent made everyone present change color. This was a Foundation Building apex strike, a world-ending full-power blow!

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. This sword light was absent from his foresight—not because his foresight had failed, but because someone had deliberately obscured the heavenly secrets! Only a handful in the entire world could accomplish such a feat. And this sword's trajectory... was unmistakably aimed at his vital point, intended to slay him in a single strike!

"Ling—Yuan—!" Chen Ji ground out the name through clenched teeth. The familiar aura within the sword intent, the ruthlessly precise technique—apart from the deeply secretive old sect master of Tianqing Sect, who else could it be? So the so-called 'three-month countdown' was not the only threat—Ling Yuan could no longer wait!

The shadow of death descended, and Chen Ji felt unprecedented crisis. The Tianji Record Fragment convulsed violently, its seal attributes fully awakening. The remaining Heavenly Fate points within him surged like molten magma, desperately seeking to pour into the Tianji Record for a thread of survival—yet he knew that even exhausting all Heavenly Fate points might prove insufficient to withstand this strike.

choice.prompt: At this critical moment of life and death, Chen Ji must make his final choice—burn his Heavenly Fate in a desperate last stand, or does he have another hidden trump card?

choices.description: Pour all Heavenly Fate Points into the Tianji Record, forcibly push foresight beyond its limits, and find the sole path to survival before the sword falls.
choices.visible_cost: May immediately exhaust all life force
choices.visible_reward: Tear open a thread of生机 within an inescapable deadly trap
choices.risk_hint: Depletion of the Heavenly Fate Value means completely losing the Foresight Ability.

text.content: Chen Ji fiercely bit through his tongue, spraying a mouthful of essence blood onto the Tianji Record Fragment. Golden characters erupted with dazzling light, and he felt as if he were immersed in the river of time, with countless future possibilities flickering frantically before his eyes. Finally—he saw it! A split second before the sword light could reach him, a boulder three feet to his left would collapse!

dialogue.content: 'Now!' Chen Ji roared, his figure mysteriously shifting three feet to the left. Sword light whistled past his right shoulder, carving away a spray of blood mist, yet failing to strike a vital point. Just then, the boulder collapsed, smashing toward the lurking shadow that had launched the sneak attack, buying Chen Ji precious breathing room.

choices.description: Activating the pact with the Demonic Path Saint Ye Qing, calling for her to rescue him. Her 'Demonic Path Mist' might disrupt Ling Yuan's perception.
choices.visible_cost: Owing Ye Qing a massive debt of gratitude
choices.visible_reward: Gaining powerful assistance in a desperate situation, turning danger into safety
choices.risk_hint: Whether Ye Qing can arrive in time remains uncertain

text.content: The contract mark in Chen Ji's soul suddenly glowed, and information only he could perceive pierced through the void: 'I have sensed it.' Ye Qing's voice was cold yet resolute, 'Move two steps to the left, and I will block this sword strike for you—but only one chance.'

dialogue.content: Before the words even finished, a wave of black mist materialized out of thin air, surging like a raging tide to forcefully intercept that sword light. Ling Yuan's form was forced to materialize, his wrinkled old face filled with disbelief. 'Demonic Path Mist? You've actually colluded with the Demonic Path!'

choices.description: Before the sword falls, speak out and reveal Ling Yuan's greatest secret—that he is the one who truly colluded with the Demonic Path, forcing Qin Mobai to intervene.
choices.visible_reward: Using the Imperial Court's hand to eliminate the greatest threat
choices.risk_hint: If Ling Yuan does not die, he will surely become a mortal threat

text.content: 'Ling Yuan!' Chen Ji's voice rang out at the moment the sword light approached. 'Do you know why the Tianji Record did not choose you back then?' The sword technique paused slightly, for that name was far too sensitive. Seizing this momentary opening, Chen Ji thundered: 'Because you have secretly colluded with the Demonic Holy Sect!'

dialogue.content: Qin Mobai's expression changed drastically, the bronze mirror in his hand blazing with brilliant light, a streak of starlight directly locking onto Ling Yuan. 'Sect Master Ling, is this true?' Ling Yuan's face turned ashen, his sword technique forced to stop—he could kill Chen Ji, but he could not openly expose himself before the Imperial Court's emissary.

text.content: Sword light, mist, and starlight—three terrifying forces collided and intertwined before the Hall of Heavenly Secrets. Qin Mobai watched coldly, his Heavenly Sovereign Sword already half-unsheathed; Ling Yuan's aged face was filled with killing intent and wariness; and Chen Ji stood at the storm's center, feeling the breath of death brush past him.

Chen Ji covered his shoulder where blood continuously seeped from the wound, yet his expression was unexpectedly calm. The three-month countdown had already begun—Ling Yuan's assassination, the Imperial Court's coercion, the Heaven's Eye's gaze... all the pieces had been positioned. And he, this 'Chosen One of Destiny,' had finally been forced onto the stage.

'Sect Master Ling, this matter is hereby remembered.' Chen Ji raised his head, directly facing those sinister old eyes. 'In three months, I will personally pay a visit to seek instruction—when the time comes, please prepare a coffin.' His voice was soft, yet carried undeniable certainty, as if it were not a threat but a prophecy destined to be fulfilled.

Ling Yuan's pupils contracted slightly. He sensed something unprecedented from Chen Ji—not the suppression of cultivation, not the crushing of a realm, but something far more terrifying: absolute confidence. This废物 disciple, this ant he had never regarded, now actually caused a flicker of wariness in his heart.

However, just at this moment, the Tianji Record Fragment trembled once more. A new prophecy emerged, golden characters branding into Chen Ji's soul like a searing iron: 'Twin Destinies—blood-connected, fates intertwined. She is the lock, yet also the key.' Chen Ji shuddered throughout, the name nearly escaping his lips—Chen Nian!

Chen Nian, his long-lost sister, taken by the Holy Sect as the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key,' his flesh-and-blood kin. The Tianji Record's prophecy told him she was not merely his weakness but the key to breaking the局面—but only if he found her within three months. And right now, Ling Yuan, Qin Mobai, even the Heaven's Eye—all were watching him.

The chess game has begun. Chen Ji slowly surveyed his surroundings, gazing at Ling Yuan's gloomy expression, at Qin Mobai's contemplative gaze, at the distant mountain silhouette where that black shadow had blocked the fatal sword strike for him. He smiled faintly, that smile carrying a resolve of burning one's boats. Three months—he only had three months. Within these three months, he would overturn all the chess players and become the one who holds the chess pieces.

The black patterns on his wrist faintly glowed with heat, the death countdown silently ticking away. Chen Ji turned and walked toward the depths of the Hall of Heavenly Secrets. His silhouette was lonely and resolute, like someone who had already prepared for death. But only he knew that beneath that composed exterior, a heart more炽热 than anyone's was burning.
